entries.summary: Pasig City Museum occupies the former Concepcion Mansion in Pasig’s poblacion. The house, completed in 1937, provides a historic setting for collections tracing the city’s development, separate from museums in Manila City itself.
overview: Pasig City Museum is housed in the Concepcion Mansion, built for former mayor Fortunato Cabrera Concepcion and his wife Victoria. Pasig architect Felizardo M. Dimanlig designed the Spanish-Baroque house, completed in 1937. The museum presents a timeline and objects relating to Pasig’s historical development. Its setting is Barangay San Jose at one end of Plaza Rizal, within the city’s poblacion. The house and the history collections are both part of the attraction.
highlights: Look at the former Concepcion Mansion.

entries.summary: The Las Piñas Bamboo Organ is a nineteenth-century church organ at St. Joseph Parish Church. Most of its pipes are made from bamboo, giving this particular instrument a distinctive place in Philippine musical heritage.

A recorded performance can introduce its sound, while an in-person performance or demonstration requires current arrangements.
